study.question: Do within-action/match-cell content/freshness joint summaries provide predictive utility beyond the incumbent count and temporal moments, content-only summaries, and the product of separate content/freshness summaries?
study.hypothesis: Observed source limitation: incumbent pools sum category, brand, action and recency embeddings, while its compact evidence contains per-action/match counts and mean/second moments of d=exp(-age/86400). Exchanging ages between different contents within the same action/match cell preserves all incumbent inputs for any embedding values. Thus it discards content-age association. The latest exclusive second moment beat its squared-mean replacement by 0.0003179572 AUC (0.620342615 vs 0.620024658) with equal parameters and about 612 vs 607 wall seconds, but this is one seed. Candidate-supplied first-512 diagnostics report 77.35% of occupied cells have multiple events and nonzero decay variance, not predictive evidence for content-age association. Hypothesis: E[d*x] per cell, x=category+brand embedding with no action/recency embedding, preserves useful recent-content identity beyond E[d]E[x]. No causal, order-modeling, production, or novelty claim is made.

nearest_work.source_ref: paper:din; arXiv:1706.06978v4; content-sha256:5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2; primary text lines 225-283, especially 266-274
nearest_work.difference: DIN uses learned target-dependent event activation and weighted sum pooling; its original activation is not softmax normalized. This candidate inherits local shared field embeddings and fixed target match groups, and adds a fixed one-day-decay joint content summary, with product-of-marginals, centered and uniform replacements. The local baseline uses softmax and is only DIN-style. Weighted pooling itself is established prior work; this is a local controlled test, not a new general attention method. Broader temporal-pooling nearest work is unverified: authorized paper searches for temporal/pooling returned no additional records.

README verifies history fields category, brand and behavior type, without item. We use only available category/brand/action/age fields; publisher full text is inaccessible in this authorized snapshot, so no detailed DMR replication or priority comparison is asserted.

Retain its entire model and add an 8192-parameter zero-initialized projection of 16x16 content/decay features into the existing 32-wide correction preactivation. Existing scalar second moments preserve age marginals but cannot recover content-age pairing.

Earlier joint-context replacement used the backbone penultimate vector to gate scalar evidence and lost to pooled context (0.619349534 vs 0.620047032). This candidate leaves pooled gating unchanged and supplies previously discarded event-level content-age association. That failed branch cautions against claiming generic context enrichment helps.

inherited_components: All frozen static and causal history inputs; no event extension or labels in forward.
Shared category/brand embeddings and target match partition from g1-r0005-match_groups.

Residual compact evidence motivated by earlier null direct concatenation g0-r0006-groups_evidence (0.618590780 below match_groups 0.618799891), and improved residual count/freshness g0-r0007-residual_count_freshness (0.619736517).
Multiplicative pooled context from g0-r0008-conditioned_evidence, RMS gate retained despite near-null detailed RMS-vs-raw result in round 9; no new normalization claim.
Exclusive action/match counts, mean freshness and decay second moment from the current incumbent; cumulative controls from rounds 11/12 remain part of interpretation.
Identical optimizer, loss, widths, supplied examples and host evaluation; no training or installations in this proposal phase.
study.proposed_difference: For 16 exclusive-match/action cells compute n, u=mean(x), j=mean(d*x), f=mean(d)*u, and c=j-f, with x=shared category+brand embeddings and d=exp(-age/86400). Empty cells are zero via clamped counts; no normalization by decayed mass. Exclude recency embeddings to avoid introducing another age marginal moment and exclude constant per-cell action embeddings. Append a zero-initialized bias-free 256->32 projection to the existing correction preactivation after all parent tensor construction. Four standalone variants select j (candidate joint_content), c (candidate covariance_content), f (control factorized_content), or u (control uniform_content). All four summaries execute in every variant. Total expected parameters 17148867 = incumbent 17140675 + 8192; expected dense 70179. Compare measured cost; do not infer efficiency from arithmetic matching. Centering is an optimization/representation contrast with the same joint and marginal information, not extra observations.
predictions: Primary contrast: joint_content exceeds factorized_content and the incumbent in full-population validation AUC, with unweighted Logloss reported alongside; improvements only over the incumbent cannot establish age/content association.
If marginal content resolution is sufficient, uniform_content or factorized_content can match joint_content; this rejects the need for the joint summary in this implementation.

Covariance_content may reduce redundant marginal mixing; its contrast to joint_content tests representation/optimization, not independent information. Any win remains provisional until paired repetitions.

Within-cell first/last age swaps preserve counts, inherited pools, first/second temporal moments, u and f to floating point tolerance, while changing j and c in cells with unequal ages and contents. This is a label-free invariance check, not predictive attribution.

Empty and singleton cells have zero covariance; all-equal-age cells also have zero covariance. Padding and joint event permutation preserve logits to normal reduction roundoff; zero-length and all-masked histories agree.
falsifiers: Neither joint-based variant exceeds both the stronger new marginal-only control and the unchanged incumbent: utility of this mechanism is unsupported under this recipe, even if a weaker comparator is beaten.
Joint-vs-factorized advantage vanishes or reverses under later paired seeds, or AUC gain is accompanied by a material quality/cost disadvantage: do not promote a repeated-support or efficiency claim.

Unexpected change in incumbent tensors or factorized summary under within-cell age swaps, nonfinite/incorrect empty outputs, singleton covariance beyond roundoff, or parameter mismatch invalidates mechanism interpretation until corrected.
Only the centered/raw representation differs while joint-vs-marginal comparisons are null: investigate scale/optimization, not new information utility.
alternative_explanations: Single fixed training seed cannot establish repeated support; adaptive validation selection remains a source of optimism.
Replacement changes representation scale, gradient pathways and effective function class despite equal allocated parameters. Centered covariance has smaller magnitude and may be harder to optimize.
Category/brand buckets are coarse and potentially hashed; association at bucket/embedding level does not establish item-specific intent or causal behavior effects.
First-512 label-free diagnostics are implementation evidence, not independent full-population mechanism confirmation.
The action-conditioned content-only summary is finer than the incumbent four pools; gains common to uniform/factorized/joint may come from this resolution rather than recency pairing.
Equal parameters do not give equal effective capacity, signal scale, or measured compute; all branches backpropagate through shared embeddings after their projection learns.
Static snapshot as-of dates remain undocumented and the prefix is truncated at 128; conclusions apply to this frozen benchmark only.

No usable scene-scoped agent memory was returned for freshness/moments/complementarity searches; absence of matches is not absence of prior evidence. Existing authorized trial receipts supply the local trajectories.

cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Preserve at least 12 frozen estimated full units (~8452.476 seconds) for up to three paired seeds of selected candidate, closest marginal control, incumbent and key ablation if budget and host interface permit. This is a future reserve, not an execution request or test-suite freeze; seed changes are not made in this proposal. Validation-only scope; no test/closed archive access.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Host hard resource limits are binding. Do not duplicate unknown-state runs, change protocol/holdout, raise caps or infer success from exhausted budget. Stop if no admissible diagnostic plus necessary attribution/repetition reserve fits, or source/shape/finite checks fail. Count failed attempts. This turn ends after source/syntax checks and proposal delivery; training/scoring are host-owned.
